name: (E)-β-Farnesene

pubchem.title: beta-Farnesene
pubchem.description: Trans-beta-farnesene is a beta-farnesene in which the double bond at position 6-7 has E configuration. It is the major or sole alarm pheromone in most species of aphid. It has a role as a metabolite and an alarm pheromone.
